_why: Mechanical resolution in scripts/site/entities.py joins strings that differ only by case, punctuation or a corporate suffix, and that needs no judgment. Saying two DIFFERENT legal entities belong to one company is a judgment, so it is written here where it can be read and argued with rather than buried in a regex. Every group states its reason. A group with no reason fails the gate.
_rule: Members are named by their exact registry string. A member the registry does not contain is ignored rather than invented, so this file can name an entity before it appears.

groups.name: Oracle
groups.note: Oracle America Cloud Services is the occupant of record and Oracle America is the operator of record. Both are Oracle Corporation entities filing in different roles.

groups.note: Riot Platforms files under its own name and under a family of site and logistics entities. It also files under an RPI prefix. Whinstone is the Rockdale developer Riot acquired.
